post.description: Starts a document extraction job in LLMWhisperer from a URL.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the document to extract. This action uses the documented URL submission path for /whisper.

mode.description: Processing mode such as native_text, low_cost, high_quality, form, or table.

lineSplitterTolerance.description: Baseline tolerance factor for line splitting.

horizontalStretchFactor.description: Horizontal stretch factor for difficult layouts.

medianFilterSize.description: Median filter size for low_cost mode noise reduction.

gaussianBlurRadius.description: Gaussian blur radius for low_cost mode noise reduction.

tag.description: Audit tag used in usage reports.

fileName.description: Audit file name value stored with the extraction run.

useWebhook.description: Previously registered webhook name to notify after processing completes.

webhookMetadata.description: Metadata string sent verbatim to the webhook callback.

addLineNos.description: Include line numbers and save highlight metadata.

allowRotatedText.description: Preserve rotated or angled text when supported.
